description: Nigeria import/export trade statistics (UN Comtrade). Returns value (USD, plus CIF/FOB), net weight and quantity where reported. `flow` is required. Filter by `partner` (country), `year`, and `frequency` (annual or monthly + `month`). `commodity` accepts an HS code (e.g. '85', '2709') OR a breakdown level: 'total' (default), 'chapters' (by HS chapter), 'headings' (4-digit), 'detailed' (6-digit). Omit `partner` to rank all partners by value. Examples: { flow:'import', partner:'China', commodity:'chapters' } · { flow:'export', commodity:'2709', frequency:'monthly', year:2024, month:3 }.

commodity.description: HS code (e.g. 85, 2709) OR level: total | chapters | headings | detailed

partner.description: Partner country (name/ISO/code); omit for all partners

name: get_trade_stats

cifValueUsd.description: CIF value in USD (imports), where reported

fobValueUsd.description: FOB value in USD (exports), where reported

hsCode.description: HS commodity code (or aggregate, e.g. TOTAL)

netWeightKg.description: Net weight in kilograms, where reported

quantity.description: Quantity in the reported unit, where available

quantityUnit.description: Unit for quantity, e.g. 'N' (number of items), 'kg', 'l'

retrievedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the record was fetched

title: Get Nigeria trade statistics
